abstract: Emerging market economies that are expected to perform well may attract more foreign capital, making it difficult to establish the causal effects of capital inflows on output. Using professional forecasts to account for expectations about future economic conditions, this column constructs an expectations-based measure of capital inflow shocks. The results suggest that capital inflows raise output by strengthening domestic demand and easing financing conditions; equity-type inflows have larger and more persistent effects, while inflow reversals impose disproportionally large costs.
abstract_zh: 预期表现良好的新兴市场经济体可能吸引更多外国资本，这使得难以确立资本流入对产出的因果效应。本专栏利用专业预测来考虑对未来经济状况的预期，构建了一种基于预期的资本流入冲击衡量指标。结果表明，资本流入通过提振国内需求和放松融资条件来提高产出；股权类流入的影响更大且更持久，而流入逆转则带来不成比例的巨大成本。
authors: Jongrim Ha, Dohan Kim, M. Ayhan Kose, Francis Warnock
title: Capital inflows boost output, even after accounting for expectations
title_zh: 资本流入促进产出，即使考虑了预期因素也是如此

abstract: The cyber threat landscape changed dramatically in April 2026 with the emergence of frontier AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic. Access to these models was initially limited, and the US imposed a de facto export ban, since lifted. This column argues that these models turn the EU’s reliance on foreign-controlled technology into a strategic dependence, widening asymmetries between jurisdictions, between attackers and defenders, and between less and more capable financial institutions. The result could be a self-reinforcing cycle of fragility. Rather than more regulation, the EU must mobilise risk capital, retain talent, and help frontier technologies emerge and scale.
abstract_zh: 2026年4月，随着OpenAI和Anthropic推出前沿人工智能模型，网络威胁格局发生了剧烈变化。这些模型最初访问受限，美国实施了事实上的出口禁令，该禁令后来被解除。本专栏认为，这些模型使欧盟对外国控制技术的依赖转变为一种战略依赖，加剧了司法辖区之间、攻击者与防御者之间以及能力较弱与较强金融机构之间的不对称。其结果可能形成一种自我强化的脆弱性循环。欧盟不应增加监管，而必须动员风险资本、留住人才，并帮助前沿技术涌现和规模化。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为欧盟战略自主、前沿AI模型与网络防御，涉及美国出口禁令，未涉及中国、中国企业、中国人群或中国地区。
title: The cost of not innovating: Frontier AI models, cyber defence, and EU strategic autonomy
title_zh: 不创新的代价：前沿人工智能模型、网络防御与欧盟战略自主

abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of one of the world's largest land conservation programs—China's Grain for Green Program—on crop production, and examines whether land retirement policies can balance ecological goals with food security objectives. By combining detailed county‐level crop production data with remote sensing data, our difference‐in‐differences estimates suggest that the program significantly reduced total cropland area but increased total crop production. This unexpected increase in production can be explained by the program's significant increase in labor input, fertilizer use, and multiple cropping on the remaining cropland. More importantly, we find that the program improved the local microclimate and substantially alleviated the damage of weather stress on crop production. Our findings suggest that, under certain institutional conditions, it is possible to adopt land‐use policy to protect the ecosystem without compromising food security.

title: How land retirement programs affect crop production: Evidence from China's Grain for Green Program

abstract: We analyze the relative importance of push and pull factors for flows by foreign investors benchmarked to the J.P. Morgan GBI-EM Global Diversified index (B) and by non‑benchmarked investors (NB) in emerging markets (EM) local‑currency sovereign bond markets. We find that global push factors—proxied by the VIX and the U.S. dollar index—are the only statistically significant drivers of B flows whereas domestic pull factors—proxied by the bilateral exchange rate and sovereign credit rating—are the only significant determinants of NB flows. A Heckman selection framework confirms that, once a country enters the index, domestic fundamentals no longer determine the amount of B investment it attracts. Despite holding about one third more assets than B investors, NB investors do not systematically offset B outflows. These findings contribute to the push-pull and original sin redux literatures by showing that B investors transmit global shocks, while NB investors respond more strongly to country-specific shocks. Among domestic investors, central banks and commercial banks tend to act as contrarian investors during risk-off episodes, whereas domestic nonbank investors do not respond systematically. The findings are robust to non-linear specifications, alternative data and different econometric techniques. Benchmark design has become increasingly consequential: B investors’ share of reported foreign holdings rose from 16.9 percent in 2010 to 42.8 percent in 2025. Index membership, the size of each country’s eligible market and the country-weight cap jointly determine how B assets under management are distributed across markets. Because the share of debt eligible for the index also varies widely, B ownership differs sharply relative to local market sizes, exposing some countries more to global shocks. Noting investors rarely switch benchmarks, we show how existing methodologies jointly affect country-universe and constituents’ share decisions, thereby determining B investor concentration and B ownership and turnover relative to domestic market sizes, and degree of exposure to global shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了以摩根大通GBI-EM全球多元化指数为基准的外国投资者（B）与非基准投资者（NB）在新兴市场（EM）本币主权债券市场资金流动中推拉因素的相对重要性。我们发现，全球推动因素——以VIX和美元指数为代理变量——是B类资金流动唯一具有统计显著性的驱动因素，而国内拉动因素——以双边汇率和主权信用评级为代理变量——是NB类资金流动唯一显著的决定因素。Heckman选择框架证实，一旦一国进入该指数，国内基本面便不再决定其吸引的B类投资规模。尽管NB投资者持有的资产比B投资者多约三分之一，但NB投资者并未系统性地抵消B类资金流出。这些发现对推拉因素文献和“原罪重现”文献均有贡献，表明B投资者传导全球冲击，而NB投资者对国别特定冲击的反应更为强烈。在国内投资者中，央行和商业银行在避险时期往往表现为逆势投资者，而国内非银行投资者则没有系统性反应。上述发现在非线性设定、替代数据和不同计量方法下均保持稳健。基准设计已变得日益重要：B投资者在报告的外国持有量中的份额从2010年的16.9%上升至2025年的42.8%。指数成员资格、各国合格市场规模以及国家权重上限共同决定了B类管理资产在不同市场间的分布。由于符合指数条件的债务占比也差异很大，B类持有量相对于本地市场规模存在显著差异，使部分国家更易暴露于全球冲击。鉴于投资者很少更换基准，我们展示了现有方法如何共同影响国家范围与成分股权重决策，从而决定B投资者的集中度、B类持有量和换手率相对于国内市场规模的比重，以及暴露于全球冲击的程度。
title: Taming Original Sin Redux: The Role of Benchmark-Driven Flows
title_zh: 驯服原罪再探：基准驱动流动的作用

abstract: Industrial carbon emissions contribute substantially to global warming, and China has the highest industrial output globally. Among the industrial sectors, iron and steel, cement, and electrolytic aluminum account for over one-third of China's total carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and are critical for climate change mitigation. This study assesses the CO2 mitigation potential, multiple mitigation costs, and cost-effective mitigation strategy portfolios of three typical industrial sectors using the global change analysis model coupled with bottom-up technology-specific models under three mitigation scenarios based on the shared socioeconomic pathways with representative concentration pathways framework. Under the carbon neutrality scenario, these three sectors contribute a cumulative emission reduction of 60.4Gt during 2020–2060, accounting for 21.1% of the national CO2 emission reduction targets by 2060. Achieving such emission reduction could result in total cumulative mitigation costs of 1019.7 billion dollars (United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, 1992) during 2020–2060 for these three sectors. Specifically, a higher CO2 reduction scenario in line with the 1.5 °C target requires more ambitious mitigation strategies, which cost 833.7 billion USD of additional costs more than the carbon neutrality scenario (CNS). Despite a short-term cost increase after 2050 in the iron and steel and cement sectors, mitigation costs are concentrated before 2040, driven by the large mitigation potential of relatively low-cost technologies such as fuel substitution and energy efficiency improvements in the two sectors. CO2 reduction strategies in the three industrial sectors will be more cost-effective than other industries, with the unit mitigation cost being 1.2%–12.3% lower than the national average. Our findings quantify the multiple mitigation costs of these three sectors and inform policy support that prioritizes earlier financing for low-cost options before 2040, continued support after 2050 for capital-intensive technologies (e.g., CCS), and sector-specific, staged transition pathways.
abstract_zh: 工业碳排放是导致全球变暖的重要因素，而中国是全球工业产出最高的国家。在工业部门中，钢铁、水泥和电解铝三个行业的二氧化碳排放量合计占中国二氧化碳排放总量的三分之一以上，对减缓气候变化至关重要。本研究基于共享社会经济路径与代表性浓度路径框架下的三种减排情景，利用全球变化分析模型耦合自下而上的技术细分模型，评估了三个典型工业部门的二氧化碳减排潜力、多重减排成本以及成本有效的减排策略组合。在碳中和情景下，这三个部门在2020—2060年期间的累计减排量为60.4 Gt，占全国2060年二氧化碳减排目标的21.1%。实现此类减排可能导致这三个部门在2020—2060年期间的累计减排总成本达到10197亿美元（《联合国气候变化框架公约》，1992）。具体而言，与1.5 °C目标一致的更高二氧化碳减排情景需要更激进的减排策略，其成本比碳中和情景（CNS）高出8337亿美元的额外成本。尽管钢铁和水泥部门在2050年后短期内成本上升，但减排成本主要集中在2040年之前，这得益于这两个部门中燃料替代和能效提升等相对低成本技术所具有的巨大减排潜力。三个工业部门的二氧化碳减排策略将比其他行业更具成本效益，其单位减排成本比全国平均水平低1.2%—12.3%。我们的研究量化了这三个部门的多重减排成本，并为政策支持提供了依据，即优先在2040年前为低成本选项提供融资，2050年后继续支持资本密集型技术（如CCS），以及制定针对具体部门的分阶段转型路径。

title: Cost-effectiveness assessment for China's emission reduction in steel, cement, and electrolytic aluminum industries
title_zh: 中国钢铁、水泥和电解铝行业减排的成本效益评估

abstract: This paper exploits China's agricultural land mortgage reform as a quasi-natural experiment to examine whether strengthening land property rights improves rural credit market performance. Using panel data from 1700 rural commercial banks across China over 2010–2018, and employing a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the reform did not lead to a statistically significant expansion in the supply of agriculture-related credit, providing no evidence of a De Soto effect under the prevailing institutional conditions. We attribute this null finding to the limited mortgageability of agricultural land management rights: neither household-contracted nor transferred management rights satisfies the core criteria of eligible collateral. These findings suggest that the realization of a De Soto effect depends critically on the surrounding institutional and market environment and requires carefully designed complementary policies.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国农地抵押改革作为准自然实验，考察强化土地产权是否能够改善农村信贷市场绩效。基于2010—2018年中国1700家农村商业银行的面板数据，并采用双重差分方法，我们发现该改革并未带来涉农信贷供给在统计上显著的扩张，未能在既有制度条件下提供德·索托效应的证据。我们将这一零结果归因于农地经营权可抵押性的有限性：无论是家庭承包经营权还是流转经营权，均不满足合格抵押品的核心标准。这些发现表明，德·索托效应的实现关键取决于周边制度与市场环境，并需要精心设计的配套政策。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: Land collateralization without capitalization: The missing De Soto effect in China's agricultural land mortgage reform
title_zh: 土地抵押化而未资本化：中国农地抵押贷款改革中缺失的德索托效应

abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how intangible cultural capital creates modern economic value through tourism. We focus on China's Tang and Song (T&S) literature (618–1279 CE), which is widely regarded as the pinnacle of Chinese classical culture and a key part of the national literary canon, and use newly compiled data on the spatial distribution of T&S literary works linked to city-level tourism outcomes from 2002 to 2019. By instrumenting local literary richness with the historical presence of famous academies and the number of pre-Tang poets, we estimate an elasticity of about 0.2 between T&S literary works and domestic tourism outcomes, indicating a substantial positive contribution of T&S literature to China's modern tourism economy. We further document that this effect is mainly driven by a demand-side force: T&S works included in the Chinese language textbooks create widely shared cultural references that increase destination salience and boost tourism demand for their cities of origin. Moreover, two complementary supply-side channels support this effect: cities with higher T&S literary output later accumulated more cultural resources and developed a richer array of tourism products. These results highlight that intangible literary canons, once standardized and disseminated through formal education, serve as a scalable demand-side asset that generates lasting, place-specific tourism benefits even more than a thousand years after their creation.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于无形文化资本如何通过旅游创造现代经济价值的因果证据。我们聚焦于中国唐宋文学（公元618—1279年），其被广泛视为中国古典文化的巅峰和民族文学经典的关键组成部分，并使用新编制的唐宋文学作品空间分布数据，将其与2002—2019年城市层面的旅游结果相联系。通过以著名书院的历史存在和唐以前诗人数量作为地方文学丰富度的工具变量，我们估计唐宋文学作品与国内旅游结果之间的弹性约为0.2，表明唐宋文学对中国现代旅游经济具有显著的正向贡献。我们进一步记录，这一效应主要由需求侧力量驱动：被收入语文教材的唐宋作品创造了广泛共享的文化参照，提升了目的地显著性，并增加了对其原属城市的旅游需求。此外，两个互补的供给侧渠道支撑了这一效应：唐宋文学产出更高的城市后来积累了更多文化资源，并开发出更丰富的旅游产品。这些结果表明，无形的文学经典一旦通过正规教育被标准化和传播，便成为一种可扩展的需求侧资产，即使在其创作一千多年后，仍能产生持久的、特定于地方的旅游收益。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: Poetry and distant places: How tang and song literature shapes China's modern tourism economy
title_zh: 诗词与远方：唐宋文学如何塑造中国现代旅游经济

abstract: We study the joint determination of tax evasion and charitable giving. A simple model in which individuals derive a warm glow from contributing to socially valuable activities predicts that congruence with the government determines whether tax payments substitute for private donations: under congruence, taxes and donations are warm-glow substitutes and donating-while-evading is dominated; under incongruence, donations retain their warm glow value while taxes do not, opening a region in the preference space in which evasion and donation are jointly optimal. We test the prediction using the seventh wave of the World Values Survey. Consistent with the theory, individuals with low levels of obedience and high prosocial motives are most likely to be observed in the donate-and-evade cell, and this concentration is stronger when individuals are not aligned with their national government---raising their odds of donating while evading by roughly one-quarter. Our results point to political congruence as a margin of tax compliance largely absent from the standard tax-compliance-and-morale literature, yet with implications for institutional design.
abstract_zh: 我们研究逃税与慈善捐赠的共同决定机制。一个简单模型表明，当个人因向具有社会价值的活动捐款而获得“温情效应”时，与政府的理念一致性决定了税款是否替代私人捐赠：在理念一致的情况下，税收与捐赠在温情效应上互为替代品，且“一边逃税一边捐赠”被支配；在理念不一致的情况下，捐赠仍保留其温情效应价值，而税收则不具备这一价值，从而在偏好空间中开辟出一个区域，使逃税与捐赠同时成为最优选择。我们利用世界价值观调查第七波数据检验这一预测。与理论一致，服从程度较低且亲社会动机较强的个体最有可能出现在“既捐赠又逃税”的类别中，而当个体与其国家政府理念不一致时，这种集中现象更为明显——使其在逃税的同时进行捐赠的几率提高约四分之一。我们的结果表明，政治理念一致性是税收遵从的一个维度，而标准税收遵从与道德文献在很大程度上忽略了这一维度，但它对制度设计具有启示意义。
title: Paying Taxes Like Uli Hoeneß -- Tax Evasion, Charitable Giving, and Political Congruence
title_zh: 像乌利·赫内斯那样纳税——逃税、慈善捐赠与政治一致性

abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on the causal effects of juvenile incarceration on long-run labor market outcomes and family spillovers. We link criminal justice records from South Carolina to rich socioeconomic data and exploit quasi-random assignment of defendants to judges with varying incarceration propensities in an instrumental variables framework. Juvenile incarceration reduces earnings and employment during early adulthood for males. These earnings losses appear to operate primarily through reduced educational attainment, changes in mental health and behavior, and societal stigmatization, with adult incarceration having a modest role. For females, our analyses suggest that juvenile incarceration significantly increases earnings. These divergent gender effects can potentially be explained by a large reduction in teenage and early-adulthood fertility, which, in turn, may increase female labor market attachment. Finally, we document negative family spillover effects: connected children in the household experience lower educational attainment, suggesting that the broader social costs of juvenile incarceration may be larger than previously recognized.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于青少年监禁对长期劳动力市场结果及家庭溢出效应的因果影响的新证据。我们将南卡罗来纳州的刑事司法记录与丰富的社会经济数据相链接，并在工具变量框架下利用被告被准随机分配给具有不同监禁倾向的法官这一特点。青少年监禁会降低男性在成年早期的收入和就业。这些收入损失似乎主要通过教育程度降低、心理健康和行为变化以及社会污名化发挥作用，而成年监禁的作用较为有限。对于女性，我们的分析表明，青少年监禁会显著提高收入。这些性别差异效应可能可以由青少年时期及成年早期生育率的大幅下降来解释，而这反过来可能提高女性的劳动力市场参与度。最后，我们记录了负面的家庭溢出效应：家庭中与之相关的儿童教育程度更低，这表明青少年监禁的更广泛社会成本可能比此前认识到的更大。
title: The Social Costs of Juvenile Incarceration: Long-Run Effects and Family Spillovers
title_zh: 青少年监禁的社会成本：长期影响与家庭溢出效应

abstract: Strengthening the competitiveness of European regions is crucial to addressing global challenges and informing effective place-based policies. We examine how international linkages – specifically Global Value Chains (GVCs) – interact with Relatedness Density to shape the Economic Complexity of EU regions, conceived as a structural precondition for long-run competitiveness. Using a detailed region-sector dataset covering the period 2000-2010, the analysis shows that the effects of sectoral GVCs participation depend on existing capabilities. Less-complex regions are more likely to upgrade their Economic Complexity when GVCs participation is coupled with a more related local activity portfolio. This study provides fresh evidence on the interplay between global and local factors in promoting more balanced regional development across EU regions.
abstract_zh: 增强欧洲区域竞争力对于应对全球挑战和制定有效的基于地方的政策至关重要。我们考察国际联系——具体而言即全球价值链（GVCs）——如何与相关密度相互作用，从而塑造欧盟区域的经济复杂性，并将其视为长期竞争力的结构性前提。利用涵盖2000—2010年期间的详细区域—部门数据集，分析表明，部门性GVCs参与的效果取决于既有能力。当GVCs参与与更具相关性的本地活动组合相结合时，复杂性较低的区域更有可能提升其经济复杂性。本研究为全球因素与本地因素在促进欧盟区域间更均衡区域发展中的相互作用提供了新的证据。
title: Complex to compete? The role of Global Value Chains and Relatedness Density in driving the Economic Complexity of EU regions
title_zh: 复杂竞争？全球价值链与关联密度在推动欧盟地区经济复杂性中的作用

abstract: This paper examines how mayoral elections in Japan affect sewerage tariffs by distinguishing between the timing of formal tariff revisions and the magnitude of realized tariff changes. Using panel data for 1161 municipal sewerage utilities from fiscal years 2014 to 2023, we find that, relative to the election year, the probability of a formal tariff revision is not significantly different one year before the election but is 1.9 percentage points higher one year afterward. The estimated effect on the year-on-year change in the monthly tariff is also positive and statistically significant in the year after the election, amounting to approximately 7.4 yen. This effect is economically small, representing only about 0.26% of the sample mean tariff. These results indicate that the electoral cycle is more clearly reflected in the timing of formal tariff revisions than in manipulation of tariff levels.
abstract_zh: 本文考察日本市长选举如何影响污水处理费，并区分正式费率修订的时点与实际费率变动的幅度。本文使用2014财年至2023财年1161个市级污水处理事业单位的面板数据，发现相对于选举年，正式费率修订的概率在选举前一年并无显著差异，但在选举后一年高出1.9个百分点。对月度费率同比变化的估计效应在选举后一年也为正且具有统计显著性，约为7.4日元。该效应在经济意义上较小，仅约占样本平均费率的0.26%。这些结果表明，选举周期在正式费率修订的时点上比在费率水平的操纵上体现得更为明显。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Electoral timing and local user charges: evidence from sewerage tariffs in Japan
title_zh: 选举时机与地方用户收费：来自日本污水处理费的证据

abstract: More connected networks are often regarded as more efficient, yet increased connectivity can elevate security risks, suggesting that sparser networks may be preferable from a security perspective. In this article, we study the trade-off between efficiency and security in networks. We develop a model in which a Defender and an Attacker engage in a two-stage game. First, the Defender builds a network by establishing costly links, where each node’s value is determined by its degree. Then, the Defender protects a limited number of nodes while the Attacker selects a node to target. Our analysis yields three main insights. First, by choosing the network’s degree sequence in the first stage, the Defender shapes the second-stage equilibrium and limits the expected loss from an attack. Second, the optimal network becomes sparser as link costs rise: a complete network is optimal when costs are low, while the centrally protected star, often regarded as the most secure configuration, arises only when costs are high. Third, when defensive resources are limited, a novel “maxi-core” structure arises in equilibrium, with a fully connected core surrounded by a sparse periphery.
abstract_zh: 更连通的网络通常被视为更有效率，但连通性的提高也可能增加安全风险，这表明从安全角度看，更稀疏的网络可能更可取。本文研究网络中的效率与安全之间的权衡。我们构建了一个模型，其中防御者和攻击者进行两阶段博弈。首先，防御者通过建立有成本的连边来构建网络，每个节点的价值由其度决定。然后，防御者保护有限数量的节点，而攻击者选择一个节点作为目标。我们的分析得出三个主要洞见。第一，通过在第一阶段选择网络的度序列，防御者塑造了第二阶段均衡，并限制了攻击带来的预期损失。第二，随着连边成本上升，最优网络变得更稀疏：当成本较低时，完全网络是最优的；而通常被视为最安全配置的中心保护星形网络，仅在成本较高时出现。第三，当防御资源有限时，均衡中出现一种新颖的“maxi-core”结构，即一个完全连通的核心被稀疏的外围所环绕。
title: Secure and Efficient Networks

abstract: Reaching net-zero CO2 emissions by 2050, as prescribed by the Paris Agreement, is hard to imagine without a carbon tax. This column estimates that reaching the goal by carbon taxation will require a tax path that peaks at around $1,300 per tonne of CO2, ten times current prices anywhere, and highlights how industries will bear very unequal transition costs. The intuitive smokestack principle, that the biggest direct emitters should pay the most, turns out to be false: costs are instead predicted by a simple statistic capturing how exposed an industry is through its supply chain.
abstract_zh: 按照《巴黎协定》的要求，到2050年实现二氧化碳净零排放，若无碳税则难以想象。本专栏估计，通过碳税实现这一目标将需要一条税收路径，其峰值约为每吨二氧化碳1300美元，是当前各地价格的十倍，并强调各行业将承担极不均衡的转型成本。直观的烟囱原则——即最大直接排放者应支付最多——被证明是错误的：成本反而可由一个简单的统计量预测，该统计量反映了一个行业通过其供应链所暴露的程度。
authors: Eric Jondeau, Côme Poirier, Gauthier Vermandel

title: The smokestack illusion: Who really pays for net zero
title_zh: 烟囱幻象：谁真正为净零买单
